item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia launched missile and cluster warhead attacks on Kyiv hours after agreeing to resume peace talks, killing at least nine civilians and injuring 57, and also struck other parts of Ukraine. Ukrainian forces disclosed a new cruise missile named Filin and reported infiltration of Russian rear areas through gas pipelines near Kupiansk and Khartiia. Ukraine announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones while noting critical capability gaps remain. Hackers linked to Russia employed a decentralised network in a cyberattack against Ukrainian targets. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
Israeli forces are intensifying attacks on West Bank olive farmers, with settler violence marking an ominous start to the olive harvest, while Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed four civilians, including a young girl, amid a looming famine risk. Israel has freed suspects in two settler attacks as West Bank pogroms intensify, and the police chief is proceeding to an Interpol conference despite orders from far-right minister Ben-Gvir. Settler outposts continue expanding, seizing land and operating with impunity. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Troops rescued four abducted victims in Zamfara and Kebbi, and police freed a Catholic priest and seven other abductees in Benue. Bandits killed passengers in road attacks on Sokoto and intercepted a vehicle, killing all passengers, and herders in Plateau were attacked, leaving two dead and six injured. Pakistan has suspended trade at two Iran border crossings and a dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing while advancing a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. The United Nations warns Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. The Taliban released 291 Afghan citizens from Pakistani prisons and a Taliban member was killed in Takhar. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
